== History ==
According to the <ref> precincts information board, it is an old shrine that was founded in the era of {{ill|Emperor Seimu|ar|الإمبراطور سيمو|arz|الامبراطور سيمو|azb|سیمو (ایمپیراتور)|ca|Seimu|cs|Seimu|de|Seimu|es|Seimu Tennō|fa|امپراتور سیمو|fi|Seimu|fr|Seimu|hr|Seimu|hu|Szeimu japán császár|id|Kaisar Seimu|it|Seimu|ja|成務天皇|ka|სეიმუ|ko|세이무 천황|nl|Seimu|pl|Seimu|pt|Seimu|ru|Император Сэйму|sh|Car Seimu|simple|Emperor Seimu|sl|Cesar Sejmu|sv|Seimu|th|จักรพรรดิเซมุ|tl|Emperador Seimu|tr|Seimu (imparator)|uk|Імператор Сейму|uz|Imperator Seimu|vi|Thiên hoàng Seimu|yo|Emperor Seimu|zh|成務天皇|zh_min_nan|Seimu Thian-hông|zh_yue|成務天皇|qid=Q316672}}, and that {{ill|Emperor Ōjin|ar|الإمبراطور أوجين|arz|الامبراطور اوجين|azb|اوجین (ایمپیراتور)|bn|সম্রাট ওজিন|cs|Ódžin|de|Ōjin|es|Ōjin Tennō|eu|Ōjin enperadorea|fa|امپراتور اوجین|fi|Ōjin|fr|Ōjin|hr|Ōjin|id|Kaisar Ōjin|it|Ōjin|ja|応神天皇|ka|ოძინი|ko|오진 천황|nl|Ojin|pl|Ōjin|pt|Ojin|ru|Император Одзин|sh|Car Ōjin|simple|Emperor Ōjin|sl|Cesar Odžin|sv|Ojin|th|จักรพรรดิโอจิง|tl|Emperador Ōjin|tr|Ōjin (imparator)|uk|Імператор Одзін|uz|Imperator Ōjin|vi|Thiên hoàng Ōjin|yo|Emperor Ōjin|zh|应神天皇|zh_min_nan|Ôzin Thian-hông|zh_yue|應神天皇|qid=Q317997}} was enshrined in the era of {{ill|Emperor Seiwa|ar|الإمبراطور سيوا|azb|سیوا (ایمپیراتور)|be|Імператар Сэйва|ca|Seiwa Tennō|ckb|ئیمپراتۆر سێیوا|cs|Seiwa|de|Seiwa|eo|Seiwa|es|Seiwa Tennō|fa|امپراتور سیوا|fi|Seiwa|fr|Seiwa|id|Seiwa|it|Seiwa|ja|清和天皇|ko|세이와 천황|nl|Seiwa|pl|Seiwa|pt|Seiwa|ru|Император Сэйва|sh|Car Seiwa|simple|Emperor Seiwa|sl|Cesar Seiwa|sv|Seiwa|sw|Seiwa wa Japani|th|จักรพรรดิเซวะ|tl|Emperador Seiwa|tr|Seiwa (imparator)|uk|Імператор Сейва|vi|Thiên hoàng Seiwa|yo|Emperor Seiwa|zh|清和天皇|zh_min_nan|Seiwa Thian-hông|qid=Q349243}}. </ref>.
